372. Hill Jumping

50

Medium  Topics

Problem Statement:
There are N hills each of height H[i] 1<=i<=N.Peter is scaling these hills and would like to ask Q questionsEach question is of the form L,R to know if he can jump from hill L to R.Peter can jump from hill L to hill R if there is no hill in between that has height of greater than the height of the first hill . i.e ( H[i]<=H[L] L+1<=i<=R )Help Peter find the answer for all his questions
input_spec: The first line contains a single integer N - the number of hillsThe second line contains N integers the heights of each hillThe third line contains a number P - the number of questionsThe next P lines contains two integers L, R- the height of the hills he wants to jump between
output_spec: The output must contain P lines- each line the answer for a questionIn each line output “YES” (without quotes) if he can jumpOr “NO” (without quotes”) if he can’t.
